name: Fdu-pb-22
summary: FDU-PB-22 (or NA-FUBIC named using EMCDDA naming standards) is a derivative of JWH-018 that is presumed to be a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor, and has been sold online as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: FDU-PB-22 acts as a full agonist with a binding affinity of 1.19nM at CB1 and 2.43nM at CB2 cannabinoid receptors.
